A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ReasonRAG research. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support comparison, including matching material relocated between sections.

before.justification: v1 reports original QA benchmark results, training-efficiency comparisons, optimization ablations, retrieval analyses, and qualitative cases.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds Search-o1 results to the main benchmark comparison.

M1.justification: MCTS/SPRE data generation, process-level preference optimization, and the three-state inference procedure remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 replaces its while loop with an equivalent for loop; anonymizing the data-generation model changes disclosure without establishing a different method.

E1.justification: Both versions construct RAG-ProGuide from PopQA, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA and evaluate on those datasets plus Bamboogle and MuSiQue. No new task, domain, population, or input scenario is introduced.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds Search-o1, previously discussed only in related work, while retaining the original twelve baselines. The appendix case figure also changes its failing comparator from ReasonRAG(base) to Search-R1, although the surrounding prose is not updated.

E3.justification: The reported splits and sample counts in Table 4, backbone specification, evaluation metrics, and optimization/retrieval settings remain unchanged. Removing the teacher-model name and hardware specification reduces documentation but does not establish changed settings or rerun experiments.

E4.justification: The case comparison changes from ReasonRAG(base) versus ReasonRAG(dpo) in v1 Figure 10 to Search-R1 versus ReasonRAG in v3 Figure 11. The failing narrative remains essentially identical, with revised response tags, so new execution is not established. Quantitative ablations, retrieval analyses, and process-judging examples are retained.

E5.justification: Both Table 2 captions specify the same two-sided t-test with p < 0.05, and retained significance markings are unchanged. No run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or dispersion-reporting information is added or removed.

E6.justification: Table 2 adds Search-o1 scores across all five benchmarks, averaging 22.2 EM and 31.96 F1. Existing benchmark and ablation scores remain unchanged, including ReasonRAG's Table 2 averages of 34.4 EM and 42.3 F1. The appendix failure example is reattributed to Search-R1 rather than presenting a substantively different answer.

T1.justification: The SPRE reward, state/action definitions, preference objective, MCTS equations, and evaluation formulas are retained. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about ReasonRAG, SPRE, RAG-ProGuide, and performance/data efficiency using approximately 5k training queries versus Search-R1's 90k. The additional comparator does not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning process supervision, generalization, SFT overfitting, retrieval saturation, and annotation costs are retained. The reward-gap paragraph expands the same preference-learning rationale, and the limitations section is relocated without substantive revision.

D1.justification: Section 2.2.3 replaces the explicit GPT-4o data-generation model with an unspecified advanced LLM, and Section 3.3 removes the shared four-NVIDIA-A100-80GB setup. The abstract changes the advertised code repository to Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/ReasonRAG. Appendix implementation details, resource links, and prompts otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds background on recommender systems, autonomous research agents, personalization, graph retrieval, and reranking, and expands criticism of prompt-based agents. It removes the GPT-4o reference. The central positioning of process-supervised RAG relative to outcome-supervised approaches remains unchanged.

P1.justification: There are localized explanatory edits, author/affiliation and conference-header updates, and new acknowledgements. The former Appendix D tree explanation moves into Section 2.2.3, with subsequent appendices relabeled; the overall narrative and section organization remain stable.

P2.justification: The existing tree illustration moves from v1 Figure 11 in the appendix to v3 Figure 4 in the main text and is reduced in size. Table 2 gains a baseline row, the case figure changes labels and tags, table captions move, and prompt figures are regrouped. Existing quantitative plots are retained.

improvement.justification: The added Search-o1 comparison modestly broadens the evidence, but v3 removes the named data-generation model and hardware specification supporting reproducibility and the efficiency comparison. It also reattributes the nearly identical failing case to Search-R1 while Appendix C still describes pre/post-optimization behavior. These losses in transparency and consistency outweigh the limited comparison and presentation gains.
